intro: The NX Pro Digital Home Locker is your trusted vault for modern living. With smart features, versatile storage, and impeccable security, it safeguards what matters most with ease and style.

features.title: Digital locking mechanism for personalized security
features.text: Set a customizable 4-6 digit password for secure access, paired with a master password option for ultimate flexibility and peace of mind.

features.title: Removable shelf for versatile organization
features.text: Adapt your storage with an easily adjustable shelf, making room for taller items or reorganizing valuables to suit your needs.

features.title: External USB charging for uninterrupted power
features.text: Stay worry-free even during low battery situations. The external USB charging port ensures your locker is always ready to protect.

features.title: Autolock keypad freeze for tamper prevention
features.text: After 4 incorrect attempts, the keypad locks down automatically, deterring unauthorized access and keeping your belongings safe.

features.title: Compatible with I-Buzz Alarm
features.text: Want to make your Home Locker even more secure? Consider adding the I-Buzz Alarm Accessory. It's like having an extra pair of eyes watching over your valuables, and it'll sound an alarm if anyone tries to tamper with it.

features.title: Emergency mechanical override for easy backup
features.text: The reliable backup key ensures stress-free access to your safe in case of forgotten passwords or low battery.

name: Nx Pro 15 Litres Steel Digital Home Locker
